title: Looks nice Works well
text: Looks nice Works well. I don't like that there is a switch on the back to go from clock to timer. The clock should always be on until you start using the timer. Minimally have the switch on the front for people that use the magnet.

product_metadata.title: ThermoPro TM02 Digital Kitchen Timer with Dual Countdown Stop Watches Timer/Magnetic Timer Clock with Adjustable Loud Alarm and Backlight LCD Big Digits 24 Hour Digital Timer for Kids Teachers -2 Pack
features: Dual Countdown Timer: Simultaneously set two alarms for separate events; This productivity timer can be programmed for durations up to 23 hours and 59 minutes, making it suitable for a variety of uses such as cooking, exercise, video game activities, kids' activities and meetings
Premium Stainless Steel Design: Unlike those minute timers made of plastic, this digital kitchen timer TM02 is built with premium stainless steel jacket design, make it more chic and durable

Adjustable Alarm Volume & Silent Mode & Memory Function: The kids timer supports to adjust alarm to high/medium/low volume levels (70-105DB) to suit your needs; Silent mode alerts you without making noise; Stopwatch timer recalls the last timer setting to conveniently allow reuse of the same countdown

Calendar/Clock Mode & Multiple Placement Options: Study timers for classroom can be used as a clock with calendar when you don't need timing; Using its tabletop stand and built-in magnet, you can place the kitchen timer digital on the counter or fridge for easy access

Easy-to-Read Display with Backlit: Clock display can be clearly and easily read on the cooking timer’s large 2.6 inches LCD screen through the large digits; Backlight function ensures you can read the time or adjust settings even under dim conditions
